steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.

Apply an Auction template before adding the line item.

Complete the Auction pricing sheet for the added item.
Invite two QA test vendors, corresponding to Vendor A and Vendor B without inventing names.
Commit a 60-minute event duration in the schedule drawer.
Publish the configured eRFX Auction event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify that Project Details exposes the bidding end-time field requested by the case.
